posts.author: maheshkumar
posts.text: Bain brought in a professional CEO (Ashish Singh from ICICI) instead of founder-led management. Banks, investors, and rating agencies trust professional CEOs more—they get better credit rates and attract institutional money. The founder stepping back as chairman removes the one-man-risk. This governance cleanup won’t show in numbers immediately

posts.author: Gaurav_Catalyst
posts.text: This is hilarious, no investor was willing to quote manappuram under nandkumar’s leadership a PB multiple more than 1.5times. Personally, investors like me can see the kind of operational trust a PE player will bring on board vs the puppets which were appointed by nandkumar to run the show. Infact, RBI too had made his life difficult because of his acts and absence of clear succession plan.
